accommodation.name: St Christopher's Inn Paris - Gare du Nord
accommodation.notes: Social hostel near Canal de l'Ourcq and Bassin de la Villette. Metro: Crimée (Line 7) or Laumière (Line 5). Direct Line 5 to Quai de Bercy bus station (15 min) - MUCH better than Madrigal for Bruges departure. Close to Canal Saint-Martin area. Hostel has bar, common areas, and social events. ~25-30 min to central Paris attractions. 15 min metro to Montmartre (Line 7 to Abbesses).

arrival.notes: Flight arrives 10:35 at Orly. Take Orlybus to Denfert-Rochereau (€9.50, ~30 min), then Metro Line 4 to Gare du Nord, transfer to Line 5 to Laumière (~40 min metro). OR: RER B to Gare du Nord + walk. Total transit: 60-75 min. Estimated hostel arrival: 11:45-12:30.

departure.notes: FlixBus departs 06:30 from Quai de Bercy, arrives Bruges 11:10 (4h 40m, no transfers). Metro Line 5 from Laumière to Quai de la Gare (direct, 15 min). Allow 45 min from hostel to bus station. MAJOR ADVANTAGE of St Christopher's location vs Madrigal (which was 25 min).

days.title: Arrival Day - Latin Quarter, Montmartre Sunset & Le Marais

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Flight arrival from Barcelona. Transport to hostel, check-in/luggage storage. Purchase 2-Day Museum Pass online or at FNAC/tourism office.

activities.name: Airport Arrival & Transport to Hostel
activities.notes: Take Orlybus to Denfert-Rochereau (€9.50), then Metro Line 4 to Gare du Nord, transfer Line 5 to Laumière. Total: 60-75 min.

activities.name: St Christopher's Inn Check-in / Luggage Storage
activities.notes: Store luggage if room not ready. Freshen up and prepare for afternoon exploration. Social hostel with bar - great for meeting people later.

activities.name: Purchase 2-Day Museum Pass
activities.timeRestriction: Available online or at FNAC stores, tourism offices
activities.notes: CRITICAL: Buy 2-Day Pass (€55) for Days 2 & 3. Activate Saturday morning at first museum. Saves €30 vs 4-day pass. Can buy online now or at FNAC/tourism office in Latin Quarter.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Can buy same-day or in advance online

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Latin Quarter lunch - student-friendly bistros and cafés around Panthéon/Sorbonne area

activities.name: Latin Quarter Lunch
activities.notes: Student-friendly bistros near Sorbonne. Try Rue Mouffetard for casual options. Budget €10-15 for lunch.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Latin Quarter literary exploration - Shakespeare and Company, medieval streets, Panthéon exterior, Luxembourg Gardens. Light arrival day activities.

activities.name: Shakespeare and Company
activities.notes: Iconic English-language bookstore on the Left Bank. Literary pilgrimage spot. Free to browse, cozy atmosphere.

activities.name: Rue Saint-Julien-le-Pauvre & Rue Galande
activities.notes: Medieval streets near Shakespeare & Co. Picturesque narrow lanes with old architecture.

activities.name: Panthéon (Exterior)
activities.notes: Neoclassical mausoleum in Latin Quarter. View exterior today, save interior visit (€11.50 student) for Day 4.

activities.name: Rue Mouffetard & Place de la Contrescarpe
activities.timeRestriction: Market best in mornings, but shops open until evening
activities.notes: Historic market street dating to Roman times. Cafés, food shops, local atmosphere. One of oldest streets in Paris.

activities.name: Jardin du Luxembourg
activities.timeRestriction: Open dawn to dusk (~08:00-21:00 in Oct)
activities.notes: Beautiful formal gardens with palace, fountains, sculptures. Relax before evening activities. Popular with students and locals.

timeBlocks.name: evening_part1
timeBlocks.description: Montmartre evening - Sacré-Cœur sunset, artists' square, picturesque streets. 15 min metro from Latin Quarter (Line 4 to Abbesses).

activities.name: Metro to Montmartre
activities.notes: Line 4 from Luxembourg/RER B to Abbesses station (15 min). Abbesses has beautiful Art Nouveau entrance.

activities.name: Rue des Abbesses
activities.notes: Charming Montmartre street. Note the Art Nouveau metro entrance (designed by Hector Guimard). Local cafés and shops.

activities.name: Villa Léandre
activities.notes: Hidden cobblestone alley with English-style cottages. Secret gem of Montmartre. Very Instagrammable.

activities.name: Place Dalida
activities.notes: Bust of French singer Dalida with nice viewpoint over Paris. Locals touch the bust for good luck.

activities.name: Rue de l'Abreuvoir
activities.notes: One of the most picturesque streets in Paris. Classic Montmartre view with Sacré-Cœur in background. Featured in many paintings.

activities.name: Basilique du Sacré-Cœur
activities.notes: White Romano-Byzantine basilica atop Montmartre hill. FREE entry to basilica. CATCH SUNSET from steps (around 19:30-20:00 in Oct). Panoramic Paris views. Dome costs extra (€6) if you want to climb - closes at 20:00 so skip today.

activities.name: Place du Tertre
activities.notes: Historic artists' square behind Sacré-Cœur. Street artists doing portraits and caricatures. Touristy but iconic Montmartre experience. More atmospheric in evening than midday crowds.
activities.cost: free (portraits cost €20-50 if you want one)

timeBlocks.name: evening_part2
timeBlocks.description: Le Marais evening - L'As du Fallafel dinner, Place des Vosges, thrift shopping on Rue de la Verrerie. Metro from Montmartre to Le Marais (~20 min).

activities.name: Metro Montmartre to Le Marais
activities.notes: Line 4 from Abbesses to Châtelet, transfer Line 1 to Saint-Paul (~20 min). Or walk down Montmartre and catch Line 1 at Hôtel de Ville.

activities.name: L'As du Fallafel
activities.timeRestriction: CLOSED Friday evening & all day Saturday. Open Sun-Thu 11:00-23:00
activities.notes: Famous falafel spot in Jewish quarter (Rue des Rosiers). Budget €8-12 for falafel sandwich. Lines can be long but move fast. Lenny Kravitz's favorite spot! CONFIRM it's Friday (open today!).

activities.name: Rue de la Verrerie (Thrift Stores)
activities.timeRestriction: Kilo Shop open until 21:00 Mon-Sat (might be closed), Free'P'Star open until 20:00
activities.notes: Vintage/thrift stores: Kilo Shop (pay by weight), Free'P'Star. Might be closed by now but street is charming to walk. Save detailed shopping for another day if stores closed.

activities.name: Place des Vosges
activities.timeRestriction: Park closed at night, but square is accessible 24/7
activities.notes: Oldest planned square in Paris (1612). Beautiful arcaded square with red brick buildings. Atmospheric at night. Victor Hugo lived at #6.

alternatives.name: Musée de Cluny (Medieval Museum)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: €9 student, 90 min visit. Too much for arrival day. Can add if you skip some Latin Quarter walking or save for Day 4.
alternatives.when_to_add: Day 4 if you want more museums

alternatives.name: Saint-Étienne-du-Mont Church
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Near Panthéon, free, 30 min. Can add if you have extra time in Latin Quarter.
alternatives.when_to_add: Add to afternoon if desired, near Panthéon

alternatives.name: Notre-Dame Exterior Walk-by
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Quick 15 min stop from Shakespeare & Co. Saved for Day 4 when doing full Île de la Cité tour.
alternatives.when_to_add: Afternoon if near area, or save for Day 4

alternatives.name: Île de la Cité Walk
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Saved for Day 4 comprehensive islands visit with Sainte-Chapelle interior.
alternatives.when_to_add: Day 4 afternoon

alternatives.name: Saint-Germain-des-Prés (Literary Cafés)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Near Luxembourg Gardens. Can add if time, or saved for Day 3 evening after Orsay.
alternatives.when_to_add: After Luxembourg if time, or Day 3 evening

alternatives.name: Maison de Victor Hugo
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Free museum at Place des Vosges. Opens 10:00-18:00 (closed by evening). Can add to Day 4.
alternatives.when_to_add: Day 4 Le Marais daytime visit

alternatives.name: Canal Saint-Martin Walk
alternatives.reason_not_selected: 5 min from hostel. Can do as evening/night activity or before sleep. Not scheduled to keep flexibility.
alternatives.when_to_add: Any evening, especially if back at hostel early

research_notes.notes: Day 1 restructured to include Montmartre sunset (better than rushing at 4am Day 5) and Le Marais evening (moved from Day 4 to free up time for Palais Garnier). Light activities appropriate for arrival day. All free except transport and dinner. Bike not recommended due to luggage and evening activities across different areas.

days.title: Museum Pass Day 1 - Royal Paris, Eiffel Tower & Arc de Triomphe

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: ACTIVATE Museum Pass today! Tuileries Gardens, Place de la Concorde, Hôtel de la Marine (2-hour visit, book ahead). Pont Alexandre III. Bike recommended.

activities.name: Bike Rental (Vélib')
activities.notes: Pick up Vélib' bike near hostel. 7-day pass (€8) or pay-as-you-go. E-bikes recommended for longer distances. Stations at all major attractions.

activities.name: Bike/Metro to Tuileries
activities.notes: Bike ride: 25 min. Or Metro Line 5 to Bastille, transfer Line 1 to Tuileries (25 min). Biking recommended for beautiful route along Seine.
activities.cost: €2.15 metro OR included in bike pass

activities.name: Jardin des Tuileries
activities.notes: Historic formal gardens between Louvre and Place de la Concorde. Morning stroll, sculptures, fountains. Part of old royal palace grounds.

activities.name: Place de la Concorde
activities.notes: Largest square in Paris. Egyptian obelisk (3,300 years old!). Site of Louis XVI and Marie Antoinette executions during French Revolution. Views of Champs-Élysées, Eiffel Tower, Madeleine Church.

activities.name: Hôtel de la Marine
activities.timeRestriction: Open 10:30-19:00, last entry 18:00. BOOK TIMED ENTRY IN ADVANCE.
activities.notes: ACTIVATE MUSEUM PASS HERE (Day 1 of 2-day pass). Stunning 18th-century palace on Place de la Concorde. Opulent apartments, Crown Jewels storage history. BOOK TIMED ENTRY ahead after buying pass. 2-hour visit.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book as soon as you purchase Museum Pass

activities.name: Pont Alexandre III
activities.notes: Most ornate bridge in Paris. Art Nouveau lamps, gold statues, views of Eiffel Tower and Invalides. Built for 1900 World's Fair. Very Instagrammable!

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Rue Cler market street lunch, or bistro near Invalides/Eiffel area.

activities.name: Rue Cler Market Street Lunch
activities.timeRestriction: Market best morning-early afternoon, cafés open longer
activities.notes: Charming pedestrian market street in 7th arrondissement. Food shops, bakeries, cafés. Pick up picnic supplies or sit at café. Budget €12-20 for lunch.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Les Invalides & Napoleon's Tomb (Museum Pass), Champ de Mars, Eiffel Tower (€14.50 student stairs ticket, NOT Museum Pass), Trocadéro views.

activities.name: Les Invalides & Musée de l'Armée
activities.notes: MUSEUM PASS INCLUDED. Napoleon's Tomb under golden dome - incredible! Army museum with armor, weapons, WWI/WWII exhibits. 2 hours recommended. One of best museums in Paris.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book timed entry with Museum Pass

activities.name: Champ de Mars
activities.notes: Large public greenspace at base of Eiffel Tower. Great for picnic, rest, photos looking up at tower. Former military training ground.

activities.name: Eiffel Tower (Stairs to 2nd Floor)
activities.notes: BOOK NOW! Student stairs ticket to 2nd floor (€14.50). NOT included in Museum Pass. Stairs are better experience than elevator - see structure up close. 674 steps but worth it! Views of all Paris. Book 2-4 weeks ahead.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Trocadéro for sunset/sparkling Eiffel views, then Arc de Triomphe rooftop (Museum Pass) for 360° night views of Paris. Bike back or metro.

activities.name: Trocadéro
activities.timeRestriction: Best at sunset and for Eiffel Tower light show (on the hour after dark)
activities.notes: BEST Eiffel Tower view! Esplanade du Trocadéro across from tower. Wait for sparkling lights (every hour on the hour for 5 min after dark - starts ~20:00 in Oct). Iconic photo spot.

activities.name: Bike/Metro to Arc de Triomphe
activities.notes: Bike: 15 min uphill along Avenue Kléber. Or Metro Line 6/9 to Charles de Gaulle-Étoile (10 min).
activities.cost: €2.15 metro OR included in bike pass

activities.name: Arc de Triomphe (Rooftop)
activities.timeRestriction: Open 10:00-23:00 (Apr-Sep), 10:00-22:30 (Oct-Mar). Last entry 45 min before close.
activities.notes: MUSEUM PASS INCLUDED. 360° rooftop views of Paris at night - see Eiffel sparkling, Champs-Élysées, La Défense, Sacré-Cœur. 284 steps to top. Tomb of Unknown Soldier beneath. Book timed entry.

activities.name: Return to Hostel
activities.notes: Bike: 30 min ride back (or return bike and take metro). Metro: Line 2 to Stalingrad, transfer Line 7 to Crimée (25 min).
activities.cost: €2.15 metro OR included in bike pass

alternatives.name: Musée de l'Orangerie (Monet's Water Lilies)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Museum Pass included, 90 min visit in Tuileries Gardens. Would need to cut Hôtel de la Marine. Can swap if you prefer Impressionism over royal apartments.
alternatives.when_to_add: Morning instead of Hôtel de la Marine, or squeeze in before lunch

alternatives.name: Grand Palais
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Currently under renovation (exterior only). Check for temporary exhibitions.
alternatives.when_to_add: Walk-by only unless special exhibition

alternatives.name: Petit Palais
alternatives.reason_not_selected: FREE permanent collection (Belle Époque art), 90 min. Near Pont Alexandre III. Would need to cut lunch time or skip Champ de Mars rest.
alternatives.when_to_add: After Pont Alexandre III if you want more museums

alternatives.name: Champs-Élysées Walk
alternatives.reason_not_selected: From Arc de Triomphe downhill to Place de la Concorde (30 min). Touristy shopping street. Can walk after Arc if you have energy, but it's mostly chain stores.
alternatives.when_to_add: Evening after Arc de Triomphe, before returning to hostel

alternatives.name: Musée du Quai Branly (Non-European Art)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Museum Pass included, 90 min, near Eiffel Tower. Would need to skip Les Invalides. Only if you prefer indigenous/African/Asian/Oceanic art over military history.
alternatives.when_to_add: Afternoon instead of Les Invalides

alternatives.name: Musée Rodin (Sculpture & Gardens)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Museum Pass included, 90 min, between Invalides and Eiffel. Would need to cut other afternoon activities or skip Champ de Mars rest. Garden alone worth visiting.
alternatives.when_to_add: Afternoon if you skip Les Invalides or shorten Eiffel time

research_notes.notes: Day 2 is Museum Pass Day 1 activation. Focused on royal/monumental Paris - gardens, palaces, Eiffel Tower (NOT on pass, must buy separately). Arc de Triomphe at night for sparkling Eiffel views from above. Long day but bike helps. Hôtel de la Marine and Invalides both need timed bookings with Museum Pass. Eiffel stairs ticket must be booked 2-4 weeks ahead (€14.50 student, NOT covered by pass - this is critical!). Budget total: €55 (Museum Pass) + €14.50 (Eiffel) + €8 (bike optional) = €77.50 main costs.

days.title: Museum Pass Day 2 - Versailles Palace & Gardens + Musée d'Orsay

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: MUSEUM PASS DAY 2 (last day - must use today!). Early train to Versailles. Palace tour focusing on Hall of Mirrors, King & Queen's Apartments, Chapel.

activities.name: Metro + RER to Versailles
activities.timeRestriction: RER C runs from ~05:30, every 15-30 min
activities.notes: Metro Line 5 to Bastille, transfer Line 1 to Charles de Gaulle-Étoile, transfer RER C to Versailles Château Rive Gauche (70 min total). OR: Line 5 to Gare d'Austerlitz, RER C direct. RER ticket costs €7.20 round-trip (zones 1-4). Arrive early to beat crowds!

activities.name: Palace of Versailles
activities.timeRestriction: Open 09:00-18:30 Tue-Sun (last entry 18:00). CLOSED MONDAYS. BOOK TIMED ENTRY!
activities.notes: MUSEUM PASS INCLUDED. Must book timed entry in advance! Palace of Louis XIV - epitome of royal excess. FOCUS ROUTE (2.5 hours): Hall of Mirrors (iconic!), King's Grand Apartment, Queen's Apartment, Royal Chapel, Hercules Salon. Skip Marie Antoinette's Estate inside palace if short on time - see gardens instead.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book as soon as you buy Museum Pass - very popular!

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Picnic lunch in Versailles Gardens (bring food from Paris or buy from garden café). Explore gardens, fountains, Grand Canal.

activities.name: Gardens of Versailles
activities.timeRestriction: Open 08:00-20:30 (Apr-Oct). Fountain shows some days (extra €10 ticket if show days).
activities.notes: FREE entry to gardens (no ticket needed - Museum Pass not required here!). 800 hectares of formal French gardens. Grand Canal, fountains (check if fountain show day - Sat/Sun spring-fall, extra €10 if shows running but worth it!). Pack picnic lunch OR eat at garden café (€15-25). Beautiful for walking and photos. If tired, skip Trianon palaces and focus on main gardens + Grand Canal.

secondaryPlaces.name: Grand Canal
secondaryPlaces.notes: 1.6km cruciform canal - centerpiece of gardens. Great for photos.

secondaryPlaces.name: Apollo Fountain
secondaryPlaces.notes: Gold statue of Apollo rising from water in chariot.

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Return train to Paris. Rest briefly at hostel or head straight to Musée d'Orsay.

activities.name: Return RER to Paris
activities.notes: RER C from Versailles Château to Musée d'Orsay station (50 min), OR to Invalides and walk 10 min. Round-trip ticket already covers return. Arrive Paris ~15:30.

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Musée d'Orsay - Impressionist & Post-Impressionist masterpieces (Museum Pass Day 2 - LAST CHANCE!). Saint-Germain-des-Prés dinner after.

activities.name: Quick Rest (Optional)
activities.notes: OPTIONAL: Go back to hostel for 30 min rest if exhausted from Versailles. OR head straight to Orsay and rest on Seine benches before museum.

activities.name: Musée d'Orsay
activities.timeRestriction: Open 09:30-18:00 Tue-Wed-Fri-Sat-Sun, until 21:45 Thursday. CLOSED MONDAYS. Last entry 17:00 (20:15 Thu).
activities.notes: MUSEUM PASS INCLUDED - MUST USE TODAY (Day 2 of 2-day pass)! Former railway station turned Impressionist art museum. HIGHLIGHTS: Monet (Water Lilies, Impression Sunrise), Renoir (Bal du moulin de la Galette), Degas (ballerinas), Van Gogh (Starry Night Over the Rhône, Bedroom in Arles), Cézanne, Manet (Olympia). Top floor has best Impressionist galleries. Architecture is stunning too! 2-2.5 hours recommended. Book timed entry.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book with Museum Pass for Sunday afternoon slot

timeBlocks.name: night
timeBlocks.description: Saint-Germain-des-Prés evening - literary cafés district, Seine riverside walk.

activities.name: Saint-Germain-des-Prés Dinner
activities.notes: Literary café district on Left Bank. Historic cafés: Café de Flore (expensive but iconic, Sartre/Hemingway hangout), Les Deux Magots, Brasserie Lipp. Or find smaller bistro on side streets for better value (€20-30 for dinner). Beautiful neighborhood for evening stroll.

activities.name: Seine Riverside Walk
activities.notes: Walk along Seine quays near Orsay. See booksellers (bouquinistes), bridges lit up at night. Romantic Paris atmosphere. Can walk toward Île de la Cité to see Notre-Dame lit up from outside.

alternatives.name: Marie Antoinette's Estate (Grand Trianon, Petit Trianon, Hameau)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Museum Pass covers it, but it's 30-45 min walk from main palace. Would cut garden time or require skipping Orsay. Only add if you LOVE Marie Antoinette history or have extra energy.
alternatives.when_to_add: After palace tour, before lunch (adds 90 min)

alternatives.name: Skip Orsay if too tired from Versailles
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Orsay is incredible and Museum Pass expires today - would lose the value. But if genuinely exhausted, you can skip and rest at hostel. Museums will always be there!
alternatives.when_to_add: Personal judgment call based on energy

alternatives.name: Musée de l'Orangerie (instead of Orsay)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Museum Pass included, 90 min visit. Monet's Water Lilies in oval rooms - very zen. Smaller than Orsay, less overwhelming. Can swap if you prefer focused Monet experience over broad Impressionism survey.
alternatives.when_to_add: Evening instead of Orsay (in Tuileries Gardens)

alternatives.name: Sacré-Cœur Sunset (if back early)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Already did Sacré-Cœur on Day 1 evening. But you live near it - can always pop up if back early and want to see it again in different light!
alternatives.when_to_add: Evening if back from Versailles before 18:00

alternatives.name: Canal Saint-Martin Evening Walk
alternatives.reason_not_selected: 5 min from hostel. Can do any evening you're back. Not scheduled to preserve flexibility. Trendy area with bars, cafés, locks.
alternatives.when_to_add: After dinner if energy remains, or any other evening

research_notes.notes: Day 3 is Museum Pass Day 2 (FINAL DAY - expires tonight). MUST visit Versailles + Orsay today to maximize pass value. Early Versailles departure (08:00) crucial to beat crowds - palace gets PACKED by 11am. RER C train is straightforward (€7.20 round-trip, zones 1-4). Versailles gardens are FREE - Museum Pass only needed for palace interior. Check if fountain show day (Sat/Sun in season) - worth the extra €10! Orsay in late afternoon is calmer than morning. Both museums require timed entry booking with Museum Pass. Sunday = no bike due to train travel. Budget: €7.20 RER + €10-25 lunch + €20-35 dinner = ~€40-65 day cost.

timeBlocks.name: morning
timeBlocks.description: Palais Garnier opera house tour, then Louvre Museum deep dive (separate student ticket, NOT Museum Pass). LOUVRE VIEWING LIST = WIP for now.

activities.name: Metro to Opera
activities.notes: Metro Line 7 from Crimée to Opéra (direct, 20 min). Or bike 25 min.

activities.name: Palais Garnier
activities.timeRestriction: Open 10:00-17:00 daily (closes earlier on performance days - check schedule). Last entry 16:30.
activities.notes: Opulent 19th-century opera house. Grand Staircase, Grand Foyer (Hall of Mirrors vibe), Chagall ceiling in auditorium. Phantom of the Opera setting! Self-guided visit 60-90 min. Student ticket €12 (NOT covered by Museum Pass). Can book ahead or buy on-site. CLOSES early on performance days - check calendar!

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Can book ahead for peace of mind, or buy on arrival

activities.name: Walk to Louvre (via Passage des Panoramas optional)
activities.notes: 15-20 min walk from Garnier to Louvre. Optional detour through Passage des Panoramas (historic covered shopping gallery, 10 min) or Galerie Vivienne (beautiful 1820s arcade).

secondaryPlaces.name: Passage des Panoramas
secondaryPlaces.notes: Historic covered shopping arcade from 1800. Stamp dealers, restaurants, old-world charm.

secondaryPlaces.name: Galerie Vivienne
secondaryPlaces.notes: Stunning 1820s shopping arcade with mosaic floors and glass roof.

activities.name: Musée du Louvre (Morning Session)
activities.timeRestriction: Open 09:00-18:00 Wed-Mon (until 21:45 Wed & Fri). CLOSED TUESDAYS. Last entry 17:00 (21:00 Wed/Fri). BOOK AHEAD!
activities.notes: BOOK STUDENT TICKET IN ADVANCE (€17). NOT covered by Museum Pass (pass expired yesterday). World's largest art museum. ENTER via Carrousel du Louvre entrance (underground mall) to skip pyramid lines! VIEWING LIST = WIP - to be added based on your interests. Plan 90 min morning session before lunch, then 2-3 hours afternoon. Monday is good day (avoids Sunday crowds, museum reopened). CRITICAL: Louvre is MASSIVE - you cannot see everything. Focus on must-sees + 1-2 interest areas.

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book student ticket 1-2 weeks ahead for Monday slot

timeBlocks.name: lunch
timeBlocks.description: Quick lunch in Louvre food court (Carrousel du Louvre) or nearby bistro in 1st arrondissement. Stay close to continue Louvre visit after.

activities.name: Lunch near Louvre
activities.notes: Quick lunch to maximize Louvre time. Options: Carrousel du Louvre food court (€10-15, stays inside), café in Tuileries, or bistro on Rue Saint-Honoré (€15-20). Keep it light - more Louvre time ahead!

timeBlocks.name: afternoon
timeBlocks.description: Louvre continuation (2-3 hours more), then Île de la Cité - Notre-Dame, Sainte-Chapelle, optional Conciergerie.

activities.name: Musée du Louvre (Afternoon Session)
activities.notes: Continue Louvre exploration. TOTAL LOUVRE TIME: ~4-4.5 hours across morning + afternoon. VIEWING LIST WIP - will be populated with specific works/wings based on your interests (Ancient Egypt? Italian Renaissance? French painting? Sculpture?). Recommended: Take break on pyramid lawn if nice weather. NOTE: You can re-enter same day with your ticket.

activities.name: Walk to Île de la Cité
activities.notes: 10 min walk from Louvre across Pont Neuf (oldest bridge in Paris - ironically named 'New Bridge'!) to Île de la Cité island.

activities.name: Place Dauphine
activities.notes: Tranquil triangular square on western tip of Île de la Cité. Hidden gem - locals playing pétanque, quiet cafés. One of Paris's most peaceful spots.

activities.name: Cathédrale Notre-Dame
activities.timeRestriction: CHECK if interior reopened post-2019 fire. Exterior always accessible.
activities.notes: Gothic cathedral (1163-1345). Damaged in 2019 fire, under restoration. CHECK before visit if interior reopened by Oct 2026 (planned for Dec 2024 initially but may delay). Exterior + square always viewable. Flying buttresses, gargoyles, rose windows (if interior open). FREE entry if open. Otherwise: exterior views + parvis (square) for 30 min.

activities.name: Sainte-Chapelle
activities.timeRestriction: Open 09:00-19:00 (Apr-Sep), 09:00-17:00 (Oct-Mar). Last entry 40 min before close. BOOK TIMED ENTRY!
activities.notes: STUNNING 13th-century Gothic chapel. 15 stained-glass windows floor-to-ceiling (15m high) depicting 1,113 Biblical scenes. On sunny day, light through glass is BREATHTAKING - one of most beautiful sights in Paris! Student ticket €11.50 (NOT Museum Pass - pass expired yesterday). BOOK TIMED ENTRY AHEAD - small chapel, limited capacity. 45 min visit. ABSOLUTE MUST-SEE!

bookingDetails.advanceTimeNeeded: Book 1-2 weeks ahead for late afternoon slot

timeBlocks.name: evening
timeBlocks.description: Optional Conciergerie (Marie Antoinette's cell), then Panthéon interior visit, dinner in Latin Quarter.

activities.name: La Conciergerie
activities.notes: OPTIONAL (time permitting). Former royal palace turned revolutionary prison. Marie Antoinette's cell, French Revolution history. Student ticket €9.50. SKIP if tired from Louvre or if Sainte-Chapelle runs late. Same building complex as Sainte-Chapelle.

activities.name: Walk/Metro to Panthéon
activities.notes: 15 min walk from Île de la Cité to Panthéon in Latin Quarter. Or metro Line 4 from Cité to Saint-Michel, then walk 10 min.

activities.name: Panthéon (Interior)
activities.timeRestriction: Open 10:00-18:30 (Apr-Sep), 10:00-18:00 (Oct-Mar). Last entry 45 min before close.
activities.notes: Neoclassical mausoleum (you saw exterior Day 1, now go inside!). Crypt contains tombs of French heroes: Voltaire, Rousseau, Victor Hugo, Marie Curie, Alexandre Dumas, Émile Zola. Foucault's Pendulum demonstrates Earth's rotation. Dome climb possible (extra fee). Student ticket €11.50. 60 min visit. CHECK CLOSING TIME - Oct hours are shorter!

activities.name: Latin Quarter Dinner
activities.notes: Dinner in Latin Quarter near Panthéon. Student-friendly bistros on Rue Mouffetard or around Sorbonne. Budget €18-28 for full meal.

timeBlocks.budget: €23-42 (€11.50 Panthéon + optional €9.50 Conciergerie + €18-28 dinner + possible metro)

alternatives.name: Bourse de Commerce (Modern Art Museum)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Pinault Collection contemporary art museum near Louvre. €12 student, 90 min. Would need to cut Louvre time or skip islands. Only if you LOVE modern art over Sainte-Chapelle.
alternatives.when_to_add: Afternoon instead of islands (not recommended unless modern art is priority)

alternatives.name: Centre Pompidou (Modern Art)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Already noted exterior Day 1. Interior museum €15 student, 90 min. Too much for today given Louvre + Palais Garnier. Can add if you skip Panthéon.
alternatives.when_to_add: Evening instead of Panthéon

alternatives.name: Musée Picasso
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Le Marais (already did Day 1 evening). €14 student, 90 min. Would need to skip Palais Garnier or cut Louvre time. Le Marais is done - moving on to 1st arr today.
alternatives.when_to_add: Morning instead of Palais Garnier (not recommended)

alternatives.name: Musée Carnavalet (FREE Paris History Museum)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Le Marais, free entry, 90 min. Already did Le Marais Day 1. Can add to morning if you skip Palais Garnier and want free option.
alternatives.when_to_add: Morning instead of Palais Garnier (saves €12)

alternatives.name: Père-Lachaise Cemetery (instead of Panthéon)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Far east 20th arr, 90 min. Famous graves: Jim Morrison, Oscar Wilde, Chopin, Édith Piaf. Can SWAP with Panthéon if you prefer cemetery to crypt. Different vibe - outdoor, romantic decay vs neoclassical mausoleum.
alternatives.when_to_add: Evening instead of Panthéon (Metro Line 2 to Père Lachaise)

alternatives.name: Saint-Étienne-du-Mont Church
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Next to Panthéon, FREE, 30 min. Beautiful rood screen, St Geneviève's tomb. Add if time after Panthéon.
alternatives.when_to_add: Evening after Panthéon if you have 30 min

research_notes.notes: Day 4 focused on 1st arrondissement (Louvre/islands core Paris) + Palais Garnier + Latin Quarter Panthéon. Museum Pass expired yesterday so today is individual tickets. Palais Garnier added per user request (NOT in Museum Pass, €12 student). Louvre viewing list set as WIP - needs to be populated based on user's specific art interests. Louvre Monday is strategic: avoids Sunday crowds, museum is open (closed Tue). Sainte-Chapelle is absolute must-see - arguably more stunning than any museum painting when sun shines through stained glass. Notre-Dame status uncertain (2019 fire, restoration ongoing - may or may not be open by Oct 2026). Conciergerie optional based on energy. Panthéon vs Père-Lachaise is personal choice: crypt vs cemetery. Budget: €12 Garnier + €17 Louvre + €11.50 Sainte-Chapelle + €11.50 Panthéon + optional €9.50 Conciergerie + meals = ~€75-95 day cost (heaviest museum day).

timeBlocks.name: early_morning
timeBlocks.description: Pack, check out, metro to Bercy bus station, board FlixBus to Bruges. Pure logistics day - no activities.

activities.name: Check Out & Leave Hostel
activities.timeRestriction: Early departure - check out night before if possible
activities.notes: Wake 05:30, final pack, check out (or store luggage and check out night before). Leave hostel 05:45 with all bags.

activities.name: Metro to Bercy Bus Station
activities.notes: Metro Line 5 from Laumière to Quai de la Gare (direct, 15 min). Walk 5 min to Bercy Seine bus stop. ARRIVE 06:00-06:10 for 06:30 bus. MAJOR ADVANTAGE of St Christopher's location - only 15 min direct metro!

activities.name: Board FlixBus to Bruges
activities.notes: FlixBus from Paris Quai de Bercy (Bercy Seine stop) to Bruges Sint-Michiels Station West. 4h 40m, no transfers. MUST have booking confirmation. Arrive 20-30 min early. Sleep on bus!

alternatives.name: Early Morning Montmartre Walk (04:00-06:00)
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Originally considered 4am wake-up for Montmartre sunrise before bus. REJECTED - too rushed, not enjoyable, misses the point of Montmartre experience. Moved Montmartre to Day 1 evening sunset instead - MUCH better!
alternatives.when_to_add: Don't. Already done Day 1 evening.

alternatives.name: Canal Saint-Martin Dawn Walk
alternatives.reason_not_selected: 5 min from hostel, could do 05:00-05:30 before leaving. But with luggage and early wake, not recommended. Canal is better enjoyed casually another time.
alternatives.when_to_add: Only if you wake early naturally and want quiet moment before departure

research_notes.notes: Day 5 is pure departure logistics. NO activities - just efficient transit to bus station. St Christopher's Inn location is PERFECT for this - direct Line 5 metro to Bercy in 15 min vs 25 min from original Madrigal location. 06:30 FlixBus is early but allows full day arrival in Bruges (11:10 arrival). Sleep on bus. Budget: €2.15 metro only (bus pre-booked). SIMPLE departure day - no stress!

must_try_dishes.description: Buttery, flaky pastry. Best fresh in morning from boulangerie.
Flaky pastry with chocolate bars inside. Morning staple.
Toasted sandwich with ham, Gruyère cheese, béchamel sauce. Add fried egg on top for croque-madame.
Classic Burgundy stew with beef, red wine, mushrooms, onions, carrots. Slow-cooked comfort food.
Chicken cooked in red wine with mushrooms, onions, bacon. Traditional bistro dish.
Grilled steak with crispy fries. Simple but quintessentially French. Order 'saignant' (rare) or 'à point' (medium).
Snails cooked in garlic-parsley butter. Classic French appetizer. Not for everyone but worth trying!
Caramelized onion soup topped with toasted bread and melted Gruyère cheese.
Rich custard dessert with caramelized sugar crust on top. Crack it with your spoon!
Apples caramelized in butter and sugar, baked with pastry on top, then flipped. Served warm with cream or ice cream.
Delicate almond meringue cookies with ganache filling. Not the coconut macaroon! Ladurée and Pierre Hermé are famous shops.
Not traditionally French but iconic in Le Marais Jewish quarter. L'As du Fallafel is world-famous. Chickpea fritters in pita with salad, tahini, fried eggplant.

drinks_and_rituals.description: Standard coffee in France is espresso. Small, strong, black. Order at bar for cheaper price than sitting.
Espresso with steamed milk (similar to cappuccino). French typically only drink this at breakfast, never after lunch/dinner.
France is wine country! House wine (vin de la maison) is usually good quality and affordable. Order by glass (verre) or carafe.
French tradition of pre-dinner drinks. Kir (white wine + blackcurrant liqueur), pastis (anise spirit), or champagne. Often served with snacks (amuse-bouches).
Thick, rich hot chocolate (almost drinkable pudding). Parisian specialty, especially at Angelina near Tuileries.

restaurants.name: L'As du Fallafel
restaurants.notes: World-famous falafel. Long lines but worth it. CLOSED Friday evening & all Saturday. €8-12 per person.

restaurants.name: La Maison d'Isabelle
restaurants.notes: Recommended by Alan as 'best croissant in Paris'. Small bakery, arrive early.

restaurants.name: Rue Cler Market Street
restaurants.notes: Pedestrian market street with food shops, bakeries, cafés. Great for picnic supplies or casual lunch.

restaurants.name: Café de Flore
restaurants.notes: Historic literary café (Sartre, Hemingway frequented). Expensive but iconic. €20-30 for breakfast.

restaurants.name: Angelina Paris (Tuileries)
restaurants.notes: Famous for incredibly thick hot chocolate. Touristy but delicious. Long lines afternoon - go early or late.

tourist_traps_to_avoid: Avoid restaurants with picture menus or aggressive touts on Champs-Élysées - overpriced and low quality
Skip the overpriced cafés directly facing Notre-Dame - walk one block away for 50% cheaper prices
Don't eat near major tourist sites (Eiffel Tower base, Louvre pyramid) - walk 5-10 min away for better value
Avoid eating dinner before 19:30 - you'll be marked as a tourist and service may be rushed
Skip branded macaron chains in train stations - go to actual Ladurée or Pierre Hermé boutiques, or local bakeries

ticket_types.name: Navigo Easy Card
ticket_types.notes: Best for 2-4 days. Load t+ tickets (€2.15 each or €17.35 for 10). Shareable card.

ticket_types.name: Navigo Week Pass (Passe Navigo Semaine)
ticket_types.notes: BEST VALUE if arriving early in week (Mon-Wed). Unlimited metro, bus, RER, tram. Requires photo. Since you arrive Friday, might not be worth it.

ticket_types.name: Paris Visite Pass
ticket_types.notes: Tourist pass. Unlimited travel + some discounts. Zone 1-5 needed for Versailles. Compare with buying individual t+ tickets.

ticket_types.name: Single Ticket (t+)
ticket_types.validity: 90 min (transfers allowed on metro/RER within Paris, not on bus)
ticket_types.notes: Buy individually or carnet of 10 for €17.35 (€1.74 each). No need if you get week pass.

where_to_buy.metro_stations: Ticket windows or vending machines (accept card, some accept cash)
where_to_buy.FNAC_stores: Navigo cards, Paris Visite passes, Museum Pass
where_to_buy.online: RATP app for mobile tickets (not yet for all ticket types)

bike_rentals.name: Vélib' Métropole
bike_rentals.notes: Best option for Paris! 1,400+ stations. E-bikes available (green bikes, cost extra €1/30min). Highly recommended for Day 2 royal Paris route. Flat areas: Latin Quarter, Le Marais, Seine riverside. Avoid biking up Montmartre hill (use funicular or walk).

practical_tips: Metro is fastest but can be crowded during rush hours (08:00-09:30, 17:30-19:30). Consider biking during these times.
Keep metro tickets until you exit - inspectors check and fine €50 for no ticket.
Pickpockets active on Line 1 (Louvre-Champs-Élysées) and Line 4 (Gare du Nord-Montparnasse). Keep valuables secure.
Many museums closed Mondays or Tuesdays - check before going. Louvre closed Tuesdays, Orsay closed Mondays.
Book Eiffel Tower stairs ticket NOW - 2-4 weeks ahead minimum. DO NOT wait!
Student ID (ISIC card or university ID) gets discounts at most museums (30-50% off).
Free museum entry for EU students under 26 at many national museums (Louvre, Orsay, etc.). Check each museum's policy.
Tap water (l'eau du robinet) is free at restaurants - don't pay for bottled water unless you want it.
Tipping not required (service included) but rounding up or leaving €1-2 for good service is appreciated.
Learn basic phrases: 'Bonjour' (hello), 'Merci' (thank you), 'Pardon' (excuse me), 'L'addition, s'il vous plaît' (the bill, please).

full_trip_overview.description: Overview of all major stops across 5 days in Paris - from hostel through Latin Quarter, Montmartre, Le Marais, Royal Paris, Versailles, and back.

alternatives_considered.name: Hôtel Madrigal (original accommodation)
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Switched to St Christopher's Inn - closer to Bercy bus station (15 min vs 25 min), near Canal/Montmartre, social hostel atmosphere, cheaper. Better for Bruges departure and social vibe.
alternatives_considered.notes: St Christopher's location in 19th saves 10 min on Day 5 departure and puts you near Montmartre (15 min metro).

alternatives_considered.name: 4-Day Museum Pass (€62)
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: 2-Day Museum Pass (€55) is more efficient. Concentrated museum days on Sat-Sun (Days 2-3). Day 1 is arrival/free sites, Day 4 is Louvre + individual tickets, Day 5 is departure. Saves €30 vs trying to use 4-day pass with gaps.
alternatives_considered.notes: 2-day pass strategy covers: Hôtel de la Marine, Invalides, Arc de Triomphe (Day 2), Versailles, Orsay (Day 3). Louvre separate ticket Day 4 (€17 student).

alternatives_considered.name: Day 5 Early Morning Montmartre (04:00-06:00)
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Too rushed before 06:30 FlixBus. Moved Montmartre to Day 1 late afternoon/evening for sunset at Sacré-Cœur - much better experience and no 4am wake-up!
alternatives_considered.notes: Day 5 now pure departure logistics (05:45 leave hostel → 06:00 at bus station).

alternatives_considered.name: Le Marais on Day 4 (original plan)
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Moved Le Marais to Day 1 evening to free up Day 4 for Palais Garnier + Louvre + Islands (all central 1st arr.). Le Marais fits better on Day 1 - arrival day with energy for social neighborhood evening.
alternatives_considered.notes: Day 4 now: Palais Garnier → Louvre (WIP list) → Île de la Cité (Sainte-Chapelle, Notre-Dame) → Panthéon interior.

alternatives_considered.name: Père-Lachaise Cemetery
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Far east (20th arr.), 90 min visit, doesn't fit Day 4 flow. Can swap with Panthéon if you prefer cemetery (Jim Morrison, Oscar Wilde, Chopin graves) over crypt (Voltaire, Rousseau, Hugo, Curie).
alternatives_considered.notes: Optional alternative to Panthéon on Day 4 evening. Metro Line 2/3 to Père Lachaise station.

alternatives_considered.name: Before Sunset Film Locations (Le Pure Café, Cour de l'Étoile-d'Or)
alternatives_considered.reason_not_selected: Niche interest, not core Paris sites. Can add to Day 1 or Day 4 Le Marais time if you're a film fan.
alternatives_considered.notes: Le Pure Café is in 11th arr. near Bastille - 15 min walk from Place des Vosges.

research_notes.notes: Paris itinerary optimized for 4.5 days (arrive Fri 10:35, depart Mon 06:30). Strategy: 2-Day Museum Pass for Sat-Sun to hit Versailles + major monuments, separate Louvre ticket on Mon to avoid Sunday crowds and maximize time. Student discounts throughout (€14.50 Eiffel stairs, €17 Louvre, €11.50 Sainte-Chapelle, €11.50 Panthéon, €12 Palais Garnier). Total museum/monument costs ~€165-185. Accommodation change to St Christopher's Inn saves time for Bruges departure and provides social hostel experience + proximity to Montmartre/Canal Saint-Martin. Bike-friendly days: 1 (Latin Quarter), 2 (Royal Paris), 4 (Le Marais). Skip bikes for: Day 3 (Versailles RER), Day 5 (departure), Montmartre uphill (funicular or walk). Louvre viewing list set as WIP - to be added later based on specific interests.
